comments: 9287f7ca: This program is used to determine the timeliness of document processing within the VistA system.
3971cbba: Initialize variables: flag, node data, deletion flag, and parameter settings from division.
75b6f265: If the document has a date/time record, retrieve it.
c1dfe959: Get the current date/time and truncate time part.
514bf937: Check if the document's status matches the expected statuses to process.
a150f60a: End of the main routine.
830eb231: For documents marked 'INCOMPLETE', calculate if the current date is within the parameter settings to flag for follow-up.
7fd11e82: If the document is 'DICTATED', automatically set the flag to indicate follow-up is needed.
34ccf893: For 'TRANSCRIBED' documents, calculate if the follow-up period has elapsed and set the flag if so.
f7bc5aff: For 'SIGNED' documents, check if the follow-up period according to the parameter settings has passed and set the flag.
7729c9c8: Calculate the difference in days between now and the document date.
